claims.claim: Hesychius of Jerusalem was a Christian priest and exegete, active during the first half of the fifth century.
Hesychius of Jerusalem was known as a priest of Jerusalem and achieved fame as a theologian and preacher.
The Greek Homily, On the Holy Martyrs, survives in only one fragment.
The homily On the Holy Martyrs is uncertainly ascribed to Hesychius of Jerusalem.
The homily On the Holy Martyrs is possibly fifth-century.
The text of On the Holy Martyrs consists of edifying comments on prayer, charity, and humility.
The homily On the Holy Martyrs is transmitted as Homily 17 (CPG 6588 = BHG 1191i).
The homily On the Holy Martyrs is marked as dubious in Migne's Patrologia Graeca.
Hesychius of Jerusalem was a prolific preacher and celebrated exegete of both Old and New Testaments.
Hesychius of Jerusalem's writings have been in part lost, in part handed down and edited as the work of other authors, and some are still buried in libraries in manuscript.
